```yaml
name: Fuzzing

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  property-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    name: Property-based Tests (Hypothesis)
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      timeout-minutes: 2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: "3.10"
      timeout-minutes: 3

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pytest hypothesis
        pip install -e .
      timeout-minutes: 5

    - name: Run property-based tests
      run: |
        echo "🧪 Running property-based tests with Hypothesis..."
        pytest tests/ -k "property" -v --tb=short
      timeout-minutes: 5

  atheris-fuzzing:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    name: Atheris Fuzzing
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      timeout-minutes: 2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: "3.10"
      timeout-minutes: 3

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install atheris hypothesis
        pip install -e .
      timeout-minutes: 5

    - name: Run Atheris fuzzing
      run: |
        echo "🔍 Running Atheris fuzzing for 60 seconds..."
        timeout 60 python -m atheris -fuzz -timeout=60 -dict=tests/fuzz.dict tests/fuzz_target.py
      timeout-minutes: 5

    - name: Upload fuzzing artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: fuzzing-results
        path: |
          *.log
          *.txt
        retention-days: 7
      timeout-minutes: 2
```
